manual_review_policy: Only missing/invalid critical fields or extraction/data problems; keyword mismatch alone is filtered out, not sent to Manual Review.
contact_policy: Contact fields are extracted from each official opportunity detail page visited. No user-provided contact is substituted. Records beyond max_details_per_run remain unverified until a later run.
tracker_policy: Only valid listings matching at least one configured keyword are sent to Florida Tracker; existing rows are never automatically deleted.
date_time_policy: Published/open and closing date-time values are copied from official API fields when available. Source timestamps are preserved; missing times/time zones are left blank rather than guessed.
